commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Gregoire Coudert dived superbly to block a header by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but Gregoire Coudert pulled off a remarkable save!
90+5' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+4' Bradley Locko (Brest) sends a long ball in, but Ruben Blanco comfortably gathers the ball.
90+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean Onana trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joaquin Correa (Marseille).

88' 1 - 0 Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Ruben Blanco is just a bystander as the ball flies low into the middle of the goal. The score is 1:0.

88' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Gregoire Coudert pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
87' The ball goes out of play. Brest are awarded a corner kick.
87' Jonas Martin (Brest) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Brest are awarded a corner kick.

86' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) receives a cross on the edge of the box. He doesn't hesitate and fires a bullet towards the goal. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper had no trouble dealing with his shot. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
85' A pass into the penalty area from Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) is intercepted by the defence.
84' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
81' That's the end of the game for Hugo Magnetti, who is replaced by Julien Le Cardinal (Brest).
80' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.

56' A clever lofted pass finds Kamory Doumbia (Brest) in space inside the box. He looks up and hits a precise shot towards goal, but Ruben Blanco is equal to it and makes an easy save.
55' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Steve Mounie (Brest), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
52' Jean Onana (Marseille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Ruddy Buquet saw the whole situation. A free kick is awarded to Brest.

34' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ruddy Buquet with no other option than to blow for a foul.

33' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Brest, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

28' Marseille get a corner.

5' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

5' Steve Mounie (Brest) latched on to an accurate cross inside the box and attempted to direct the ball with a nice header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep the ball out. Now Brest have a corner.

4' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Ruben Blanco, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
